text:
alex: Quick sync — need a final decision on the ingress handshake state machine. Open questions: reuse session tokens across reconnects? how to serve partial streaming results on reconnects?

jia: My preference: allow short-window token reuse (eg 30s) so clients can reconnect without full regen. Token must encode idempotency vector + last-seq.

sam: Concern: replay/stale token use after failover between regions. How do we avoid a token issued in region-a being accepted in region-b after leader change?

mohit: Proposal: tokens include (region, lease_id, seq) and are signed by edge KMS. New edge checks lease_id validity; if lease expired or doesn't match, reject. That prevents silent cross-region replay.

alex: Ops implications: we need a lease registry + fast revocation on restart. Is that extra complexity acceptable?

jia: :thumbsup: we already have ephemeral leases for session affinity. TTL <= 60s should keep surface area small. We can reuse the existing lease heartbeat.

sam: Partial responses: do clients request resume from last-seq or does edge provide a delta?

mohit: Mechanically: client sends a RESUME_OFFER with {session_token, last_seq}. Edge validates and asks runtime for fast-forward(last_seq). Runtime returns one of: MISSING_CHUNKS (list), FULL_REGEN, or OK (no gaps). If FULL_REGEN -> client must re-send prompt.

alex: For user-facing behavior, we should map FULL_REGEN -> HTTP 409 / gRPC code + human-friendly message and include a "regeneration_hint" (approx tokens lost). Also emit metric regen_rate.

jia: We should track resume_success_rate, resume_latency_p95, resume_fail_reasons. Also add a log rubric for reasons (lease_mismatch, cache_miss, invalid_signature).

sam: Wire format: add minimal frames: RESUME_OFFER, RESUME_ACCEPT, RESUME_REJECT with compact codes. Keep frame overhead small (1 byte type, varint seq, optional payload).

alex: Sketch of state transitions (very small):

```
INIT -> HANDSHAKE
HANDSHAKE -> STREAMING    (on HANDSHAKE_ACK)
STREAMING -> RESUME_PENDING (on connection interrupt)
RESUME_PENDING -> STREAMING (on RESUME_ACCEPT)
RESUME_PENDING -> CLOSED  (on RESUME_REJECT or timeout)
STREAMING -> CLOSED       (on EOF)
```

jia: Edge should garbage-collect RESUME state after resume_ttl (configurable, default 30s). Also limit number of resume attempts per session to prevent abuse.

mohit: Security: sign tokens with rotating KMS keys (rotate daily). Include key_id in token so edges can verify quickly. For region failover we reject lease_ids not in current registry.

sam: Performance: fast-forward should be optimized to return a compact diff (list of cached prefix KV ranges) rather than token-by-token. Runtime side: store last N KV checkpoints for each session.

alex: Tradeoffs recap:
- pros of reuse: lower latency for real reconnects, preserves KV cache benefits.
- cons: more state & lease machinery, complexity in failover.

Decision proposal: implement short-ttl signed session tokens bound to lease_id+region; support RESUME frames + the fast-forward API; default resume_ttl=30s and max_attempts=3. If runtime cannot fast-forward, return FULL_REGEN -> client must re-request.

jia: +1 to proposal. I'll start a small RFC doc with the frame spec and metrics.

mohit: I'll draft the token format and lease validation pseudo-code.

sam: I'll proof the fast-forward diff shape and add runtime perf constraints.

alex: Action items: Jia -> RFC, Mohit -> token PR, Sam -> runtime changes. Sync Friday 11am.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created checklist item: "ingress-resume-rfc" in #architecture-tracker (open).
